text.tspan: 1. Sending SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Push, webhooks
2. Types of notifications i.e. Transactional, Promotional, General, etc.
Fetch template details based on template ID
Each broker can have multiple topics
i.e. SMS, WhatsApp, Email, Push, Webhook
Template table will consist of templates created.
It will have pre-defined format of SMS, WhatsApp, Email or Push notification format.
Just the place-holders that will be taken from the client will be replaced.
In case of webhook, it will have the webhook URL pre-defined along with the parameters.
User just need to pass the template ID of that webhook along with the placeholders and the API will be triggered.
The individual Consumer group will be responsible for sending all types of notifications
i.e. SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Webhook, etc.
Trigger Callback received in notification metadata to update the client about success/failure
Every consumer will access a respective broker; each broker can have multiple topics.
In case of SMS, Email, WhatsApp, Push notifications, we will have 3rd party services integrated, i.e., Kaleyra, Exotel, AWS SES, SendGrid, FCM, APN, etc.
In case of Webhook, we will be directly calling the Webhook API we have configured in the Template table with the parameters we are getting from client.
Each topic will have retries and DLQ
If msg is not sent in 1st attempt, it will retry
After all configured retry attempts, it will push to DLQ
